cause_quote: The diff replaced “summarizeToolGroup(activity, { includeFailureCount: opts.expanded })” with “const label = duration ? t("chat.workRun.workedFor", { duration }) : t("chat.workRun.worked");”, removing the operation counts while keeping failure badges.
user_saw: A collapsed Control UI work summary could show “20 failed” with no indication that the run made 200 tool calls.
summary: The fix displays one total tool-call count alongside the outcome badges and reconciles prepared activity with raw tool cards to avoid double-counting.
reasoning: I checked the renderer diff and its parent’s grouping code. Before #156926, the collapsed header showed per-operation counts such as “1 read” alongside failures, which the prior test assertions confirm. #156926 replaced those counts with the duration heading while retaining failure badges, and #157904 restores that context as a single total.
